owningLane.scope: Official PDF acquisition, field mapping and overlay for the Board's military Eligibility Acknowledgement. Lane D also owns resolving the undated-revision question (cf-04) as part of source capture.

orderingRuleNote: Not asserted. The acknowledgement-first rejection rule ("the petition must contain the Certificate of Sealing Acknowledgement Form along with all of the following or it will be rejected and returned") is recorded on the Certificate of Sealing Guidelines. Whether the military acknowledgement carries the same consequence is not separately stated, so no ordering rule is asserted here. Counsel flag cf-04.

manualCompletion: Witness or attorney signature on the acknowledgement — Signature of Witness/Attorney. Third-party completed. LegalEase leaves it blank.
